notes: Changed file is a shell script (util/grub.d/30_os-prober.in), no C compilation required
Testing via isolated mocked harness that exercises old and new matching logic
grub_probe mocking provides predictable UUIDs for test devices
Full grub2 build not required for unit-level compatibility verification of regex matching logic

entries.expected_signal: All 18 tests pass, confirming both old bug behavior and new fix behavior
entries.reachability_signal: Exercises old and new regex matching paths for GRUB_OS_PROBER_SKIP_LIST

contracts.detail: Contract comparison: old code required @device suffix in SKIP_LIST for non-EFI (UUID-only entries silently ignored). New code correctly matches UUID-only entries and accepts @/dev/* deprecated format with warning. EFI entries work identically in both versions. Comma and semicolon are accepted as additional separators.

behavior_differences.before: UUID-only entry in SKIP_LIST for non-EFI device: noskip (BUG — silently ignored)
behavior_differences.after: UUID-only entry in SKIP_LIST for non-EFI device: skip (FIXED)
behavior_differences.evidence: Old code: EXPUUID always appended @device suffix, making UUID-only entries not match. New code: non-EFI path uses EXPUUID='UUID(@/dev/.*)?' which matches UUID-only entries.

behavior_differences.after: UUID@sda1 in SKIP_LIST: noskip (rejected, only @/dev/* accepted)
behavior_differences.evidence: New code for non-EFI: EXPUUID='UUID(@/dev/.*)?' does not match 'UUID@sda1' in SKIP_LIST (sda1 lacks /dev/ prefix). Users must use UUID@/dev/sda1 for backward compat.

behavior_differences.before: Comma/semicolon as UUID separators: not explicitly supported (relied on \b word boundary)
behavior_differences.after: Comma and semicolon explicitly accepted as separators (SPACE='[[:space:],;]')
behavior_differences.evidence: New code explicitly includes comma and semicolon in SPACE regex pattern for entry separation.

behavior_differences.before: No deprecation warning for any SKIP_LIST format
behavior_differences.after: Deprecation warning emitted to stderr when SKIP_LIST contains UUID@/dev/* entries
behavior_differences.evidence: New case statement checks for *@/[dD][eE][vV]/* pattern and calls grub_warn with deprecation message.

notes: Test covers: UUID-only (bug fix), @device rejection, @/dev/* backward compat, deprecation warning, comma/semicolon/space separators, exact matching, EFI paths, empty lists
Old code bug confirmed: UUID-only SKIP_LIST entries never worked for non-EFI because EXPUUID always got @device suffix appended
New code fixes the bug while maintaining backward compatibility for UUID@/dev/* format
PCA-0002 (SIDE_EFFECT_CHANGE - deprecation warning) is verified as part of the CONFIG_CLI_BEHAVIOR_CHANGE testing

conclusion.rationale: 补丁修复了 GRUB_OS_PROBER_SKIP_LIST 配置变量的两个缺陷：(1) 非 EFI 系统上仅 UUID 的跳过条目静默失效（现修复为正确生效），(2) 单词边界正则导致的 UUID 部分匹配误报（现改为显式分隔符锚定匹配）。存在向后不兼容的行为变化：旧版接受 UUID@sda1 格式的 SKIP_LIST 条目（现在被拒绝，需使用 UUID@/dev/sda1），且新增了弃用警告输出。但鉴于旧行为已在文档中描述为 bug，此变更应视为向前改进而非破坏性兼容性问题。
recommended_actions: 检查现有 /etc/default/grub 配置中是否使用了 'UUID@sda1' 格式的 GRUB_OS_PROBER_SKIP_LIST 条目，应迁移为 'UUID'（仅 UUID）或 'UUID@/dev/sda1'（弃用格式）
如果自动化脚本解析 grub-mkconfig 的 stderr 输出，需注意新增的弃用警告消息
验证非 EFI 系统上仅 UUID 的跳过行为符合预期，确保文档与实际行为一致
验证 EFI 链式加载器（UUID@EFI_PATH）的跳过行为不受影响
